row:
As a 501 (C)3 our mission is to end the slaughter pipeline by rescuing, sheltering and treating  horses with love and compassion.  We also do our best to take in surrendered animals that might end up at the auction or their owners are unable to care for them.  We have recently become a Full Circle of Life Shelter.  Commited to do what is best for the animals.

Subscribe to our channel now to see what exciting adventure we get into next. It is only with the support and help of our subscribers we can go out and save more horse, mules, donkeys and other farm animals in need of a safe home. 

We look forward to see you all as we help as many animals as we can.
